Once the page opens, add your API key under `Settings → Models` in"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" Harness, then confirm a directory in `Choose workspace` and start a session."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"`workingDirectory` is DSH's launch directory and default workspace context, which affects `AGENTS.md"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"`, `CLAUDE.md`, cwd `.env`, and similar files."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Commands"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Command | Description |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| `DeepSeek Harness Launcher: Open` | Start if needed, or open the running UI |

| `DeepSeek Harness Launcher: "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"Open in Browser` / `DeepSeek Harness Launcher: Open in VS Code` | Start if needed, then open in the "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"chosen location |

"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"| `vscode-dsh.environment` | Process environment variables; may override `PATH`, cannot override `DS"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"vironment` | Process environment variables; may override `PATH`, cannot override `DSH_HOME` | `{}` |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`DeepSeek Harness Launcher: Open` is the primary command: it starts the server when it is not runnin"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"g and opens it directly when it is."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Status Bar"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The status bar shows: shield + `DSH` (untrusted), `DSH` (not running), `DSH Working…` (click to canc"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"el or view output), `DSH Stopping…` (click for output), `DSH: port` (hosted by this window), link ic"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"on + `DSH: port` (external server), `DSH: port*` (settings changed; click to restart and apply), or "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"error icon + `DSH` (hover for details and click for recovery actions)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Managed and External Servers"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- A managed server is started by the extension. Its data lives in the extension's global storage, so"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" model credentials, settings, and sessions are shared across projects. A single-writer lease keeps t"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"he profile safe; another VS Code window automatically connects to the running shared instance instea"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"d of starting a competing process. "Stop Server" waits for the session to clean up, then force-ends "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"it and confirms the port was released.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Security and Privacy"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- Use Harness only with projects you fully trust. `workingDirectory` and any added directories may b"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"e read, written, and executed by the agent. Workspace Trust is not a filesystem sandbox.
- The exten"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"sion always passes `--host 127.0.0.1`, refuses to let users override the listen address, and does no"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"t support patches that would rewrite this boundary.
- The upstream Web service has no authentication"},{"id":"p27s5","text":" or TLS suitable for the public internet. The first startup downloads a pinned top-level DSH version"},{"id":"p27s6","text":" from npm; transitive dependencies may still change.
- API keys, model configuration, and sessions a"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"re written by DSH to the extension's global application profile and are shared across projects in th"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"e same environment. This extension does not read API keys and contains no telemetry."}],"truncated":true}
